root.label: Trial begins for Miguel Salguero Olivares in Faith Hedgepeth murder case

events.label: Trial begins for Miguel Salguero Olivares in Faith Hedgepeth murder case

slots.name: number of charges
slots.sentence: Miguel Salguero Olivares is charged with first-degree murder, rape and burglary in the death of Faith Hedgepeth.

slots.name: DNA evidence locations
slots.sentence: In her opening statement, Assistant District Attorney Angela Garcia-Lamarca said the defendant left his DNA on the murder weapon – a bottle of rum found covered in blood – inside Hedgepeth’s body and on a note written on a fast-food bag found at the scene.

slots.name: home arrival time
slots.sentence: Garcia-Lamarca said Hedgepeth and her roommate had been at a popular club that night, and that Hedgepeth, the designated driver, drove them home around 2 a.m.

slots.name: roommate departure time
slots.sentence: The roommate was drunk and sick, she said, but later called a friend to come pick her up around 4 a.m.

slots.name: time until discovery
slots.sentence: She returned hours later and found Hedgepeth dead.
